heading: Actions covered
lead: This subchapter applies to a removal from the civil service or suspension for more than 14 days, but does not apply to an action initiated under section 1215 of this title, to a suspension or removal under section 7532 of this title, or to a removal under section 3592 or 3595 of this title.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1989—Pub. L. 101–12 substituted “1215” for “1206”. 1981—Pub. L. 97–35 inserted reference to section 3595 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1989 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 101–12 effective 90 days following Apr. 10, 1989, see section 11 of Pub. L. 101–12, set out as a note under section 1201 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1981 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 97–35 effective June 1, 1981, with certain exceptions and conditions, see section 1704(e) of Pub. L. 97–35, set out as an Effective Date note under section 3595 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective 9 months after Oct. 13, 1978, and congressional review of provisions of sections 401 through 412 of Pub. L. 95–454, see section 415 of Pub. L. 95–454, set out as a note under section 3131 of this title.
